description.value:
From Weather Report · Price: it needs open sky for anything beyond fog.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 2 actions: fog in a @Template[burst|distance:15]{15-ft burst} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{concealed}) for 1 minute, or calm the wind. 1 action, outdoors: hail on a creature within 30 ft: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[cold]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}); @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn on a failure.
  • 5: Surge, outdoors: rain or wind in a @Template[burst|distance:30]{30-ft burst} for 1 minute: difficult terrain and –2 to ranged attacks, for creatures you choose. Also 1 action: pull moisture from a creature's surroundings: it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 3} on a critical failure; @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates), once per creature per day. Surge, outdoors: lightning strike on one creature: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[electricity]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}); @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1} on a critical failure.
  • 9: No change.
  • 13: The lightning strike forks to up to 3 creatures, and you can pull moisture from up to 3 creatures with one action.
  • 17: Once per day, outdoors: heavy weather for 1 minute: every non-ally creature in 60 ft attempts @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} each round or is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1}. The lightning strike forks to up to 5 creatures.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.cB3MERInqYODgMJQ]{Effect: Storm Weather}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
